text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High p95 latency observed for /v1/generate across us-west-2 (started ~10m ago). Paging on-call.

erin: oncall paging received. I'm grabbing traces and perf counters now. ETA 5m.

jen-oncall: I'm live. Customers A/B on Dedicated are seeing 4-6x p95, some 503s. Any mitigation recommended?

samir: rolling a temporary routing policy to route traffic away from constrained GPU pool to standby pool (canary first). Starting canary now.

paula: noted customer impact: two enterprise customers reported timeouts. Eng-SRE has notified CS to prepare incident banner.

max: can you paste the high-level p50/p95 numbers from the dashboard? I have a baseline chart open.

erin: p50 ~ 120ms -> 150ms (small); p95 jumped 220ms -> 1.4s. Error rate up from 0.2% -> 1.8% for that route.

alisha: any config/rolling deploys in last 2 hours? I see a kernel backport that landed on a subset of nodes 2h ago (linux-5.15.*). Could be related.

samir: infra-bot, show perf counters sample for affected instances.

infra-bot: perf snapshot attached: cpu-steal low, cache-misses up ~3x, context-switches up ~2x. Attaching sample spans: /v1/generate -> attention_kv_fetch increased time in some replicas.

jen-oncall: can we redirect traffic to older kernel nodes only while we investigate? Samir already started a canary redirect.

samir: canary shows 60% of traffic to standby pool, p95 on canary nodes ~160ms. On impacted nodes p95 remains ~1.2s. Slowly moving more traffic.

paula: CS: sending proactive messages to impacted customers. ETA banner in 8m. We need timeline and hypothesis for RCA.

erin: sharing logs and a short timeline here:
- T-120m: kernel patch rollout begins to subset of infra
- T-35m: first p95 uptick detected by alerting (ops-bot)
- T-30m: alert escalated to on-call
- T-25m: initial mitigation (canary routing) started
- T-5m: 80% traffic moved off impacted pool; p95 trending down on overall but still elevated for specific replicas.

jen-oncall: hypothesis 1: kernel scheduler change increased runqueue latency for attention-heavy workloads causing tail latency (esp. when combined with our continuous batching). Hypothesis 2: new kernel page reclaim behavior causing increased cache misses leading to more DRAM latency on KV cache access.

max: any trace spans showing increased syscalls or futex waits?

erin: yes — trace sample shows increased time in syscall: futex_wait and a spike in page-faults where kv-cache lookups cross huge pages boundary. snippet:
```
span: kv_lookup
  db:0.002ms
  kv_fetch: 0.18ms -> 0.9ms (tail)
  syscall: futex_wait +9ms
  page_fault: increased
```

alisha: I can repro locally on a node with the kernel backport. Running stress with attention workload reproduces p95 shift. Reverting kernel patch on one node dropped p95 back to baseline.

samir: good. For mitigation we should: 1) keep traffic off patched nodes, 2) open rollback with infra (if rollout automated), 3) collect full perf.data for RCA.

jen-oncall: I'm handing off to infra team for rollback and deeper perf collection. Erin, Samir, please coordinate on traces and perf artifacts. I'll update incident channel and CS.

erin: uploading flamegraphs + perf.data to /mnt/incidents/1789990000/ and sharing link: s3://redwood-incidents/1789990000/perf.tgz

paula: CS banner posted: "We are investigating increased latency in US-WEST affecting some customers. Mitigation in progress." ":mega:"

samir: rolling back automated kernel rollout (job id: kube-rolling-9876). Started at T+12m. Monitoring.

infra-bot: rollback started. Expected completion 8m.

jen-oncall: thanks — handoff to infra and eng-ml for RCA. I'll remain available for customer updates. Assigning action items:
- erin: collect final trace bucket and link to timeline
- samir: confirm rollback fully completes and nodes drain
- alisha: attempt reduced repro and document steps
- max: write initial RCA doc stub after we have perf artifacts

max: noted. I'll create the initial RCA stub in docs/incidents/1789990000-rca.md and link artifacts.

erin: attaching initial hypothesis notes and sample spans in the thread. Will add perf counters (L1/L2 misses, page-faults) in the doc.

paula: keeping CS posted. Any ETA on when p95 fully normalizes for impacted customers?

samir: projected 10-15m after rollback finishes for p95 to normalize. Will post updates.

jen-oncall: handing off incident to infra for rollback completion and post-rollback validation. If anything regresses, page me.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: rollback completed. p95 back to ~140ms on previously impacted pool. Continue RCA in follow-up thread.

alisha: confirmed repro steps and kernel diff. Will paste patch lines and perf counters in the RCA doc.

max: created RCA stub: docs link s3://redwood-incidents/1789990000/rca.md. Moving to postmortem stage; labeling root cause as candidate: kernel scheduler/backport interaction with continuous batching causing increased tail latency. Will fill with timelines and artifacts.

jen-oncall: closing live paging. Great work team. :tada:
_extra_note: This thread is a reconstructed Slack incident conversation capturing paging, live mitigation, handoff, log/trace sharing, and initial RCA coordination for a latency regression tied to a kernel backport.
